title: Implement Certifications section variant (certifications-logos)
description: Implement a Certifications section displaying industry certifications, accreditations, and licenses. Shows logo images or text badges.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: CertificationsContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders all certifications with name, optional logo image, optional year

Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

Take Playwright screenshot. Confirm certifications are displayed correctly.
